gloss: same-day ticket; day ticket; door ticket

definitions.gloss: same-day ticket; day ticket; door ticket
definitions.explanation: a ticket purchased on the day of the event, as opposed to tickets bought in advance

examples.japanese: {当日券|とうじつけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れ→売り切れ：09556_urikire⟧だった。
examples.english: The same-day tickets were sold out.

examples.japanese: {当日券|とうじつけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前売|まえう}り→前売り：08289_maeuri⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Same-day tickets are more expensive than advance tickets.

examples.japanese: {当日券|とうじつけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めて→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: I lined up from the morning to get same-day tickets.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧ (same day) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket)

PRICING:
{当日券|とうじつけん} is typically priced higher than ⟦{前売|まえう}り{券|けん}→前売り券：18268_maeuriken⟧ (advance tickets), often by 500-1000 yen.

AVAILABILITY:
For popular events, {当日券|とうじつけん} may:
- Sell out quickly
- Not be available at all
- Be limited in quantity

RELATED WORDS:
